doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: early life and first bands
title: Bailey's father and a repeat of the first band question
summary: Bailey says he did not know his father; the interviewer asks again about his first band and gets Young Tuxedo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. What, um, did your daddy play an instrument? Do you remember?
My daddy? Yeah. I don't know my daddy. No, you don't know my daddy? No, you don't know my daddy? My daddy and my mama.
Dying out as a baby. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
I told him, my mom and dad were born, described me as my mama. What was the first band you played with? The very first band, can you remember that?
Um, Young Tuxedo, my brother. Oh, yeah, yeah, you told me that.
